document.abstract: A brief account of the various uses of the motion picture camera in the Army Air Forces. A number of examples of such uses are given and it is pointed out that new demands coming in regularly make it reasonable to believe that the only limitation of the use of motion pictures in the total war effort will be the number of cameras and cameramen available.
